ja: 彼は緊張してると思う。
en: I think he's nervous.
alternatives: I guess he's nervous.
I'd say he's nervous.
point: 「〜と思う」は I think ＋ 文

ja: この町は楽しい所が多い。
en: There are many fun places here.
alternatives: This town has lots of fun places.
This town has plenty of fun spots.
point: 「〜が多い」は There are many で言える

ja: 彼はなぜ怒ってるのか分からない。
en: I can't figure out why he's upset.
alternatives: I don't get why he's so upset.
I have no idea why he's angry.
point: 間接疑問は why he's と平叙文の語順

ja: 私は少し安堵を感じる。
en: I feel a little relief.
alternatives: I feel slightly relieved.
I feel a bit relieved.
point: 気持ちとしての relief は数えず a little relief。

ja: あの一言、飲み込めばよかった。
en: I wish I'd bitten my tongue.
alternatives: If only I'd bitten my tongue.
I wish I'd kept my mouth shut.
point: bite one's tongue は言葉をぐっと飲み込む

ja: 彼が軽んじられたと思う訳は分かる。
en: I get why he feels he's been slighted.
alternatives: I understand why he thinks he's been disrespected.
I get why he feels slighted.
point: slighted は軽んじられたと感じること。

ja: 君の立場なら控えめな賛辞で案をけなす。
en: In your shoes, I'd damn it with faint praise.
alternatives: In your place, I'd criticize it with faint praise.
I'd give it faint praise in your place.
point: damn with faint praise は弱い賛辞で逆にけなす。

ja: 私はこんな恨みを抱くと思わなかった。
en: Little did I imagine I'd harbor such resentment.
alternatives: I never imagined I'd nurse such a grudge.
I never thought I'd resent it this much.
point: harbor resentment は恨みを心に抱き続ける。

ja: 一人で歩くのは平気だよ。
en: I don't mind walking alone.
alternatives: I don't mind walking by myself.
Walking alone doesn't bother me.
point: mind の後は -ing

ja: 言い返してれば、今すっきりなのに。
en: If I'd spoken up, I'd feel better now.
alternatives: If I had spoken up, I would feel better now.
If I'd said something, I'd feel better now.
point: 過去の仮定 + 今の結果は had done と would

ja: 君に考え直してほしい。
en: I want you to reconsider.
alternatives: I want you to rethink it.
I'd like you to think again.
point: reconsider は一度決めたことを考え直す。

ja: ひと言いいですか？
en: May I say something?
alternatives: Could I say something?
Is it okay to say something?
point: 丁寧に許可を求める May I / Could I

ja: 一人になってもいい？
en: Can I be alone?
alternatives: Can I have some time alone?
Can I have a minute alone?
point: 許可を求める Can I 〜? に be alone を続ける

ja: 私、彼の気分を害したかもしれない。
en: I might have hurt his feelings.
alternatives: I may have hurt his feelings.
I might have offended him.
point: might have + 過去分詞で「かもしれなかった」

ja: 無理しないほうがいいよ。
en: You shouldn't push yourself.
alternatives: You shouldn't overdo it.
You'd better not push yourself.
point: 「〜しないほうがいい」は shouldn't

ja: 彼が漏らした秘密が気がかりだ。
en: The secret he spilled worries me.
alternatives: I worry about the secret he revealed.
The secret he let slip concerns me.
point: spill a secret は秘密を漏らす。

ja: 今、わくわくしてる！
en: I'm feeling excited.
alternatives: I'm so excited!
I'm really excited!
point: 今の気持ちは進行形 I'm feeling 〜

ja: 私は怒ってない。
en: I'm not angry.
alternatives: I don't feel angry.
I'm not mad.
point: not angry で怒っていないと伝える。

ja: 会えてうれしいよ。
en: I'm glad to see you.
alternatives: I'm happy to see you.
It's nice to see you.
point: 気持ちの理由は形容詞 + to 不定詞

ja: 今週ずっと、彼が心配なんだ。
en: I've been worrying about him all week.
alternatives: I've been worried about him all week.
He's been on my mind all week.
point: ずっと続く気持ちは現在完了進行形

ja: 泣かないでね。
en: Please don't cry.
alternatives: Don't cry, okay?
Try not to cry.
point: 否定の命令文は Don't と動詞の原形。

ja: 君に私の話に合わせてほしい。
en: I want you to humor me.
alternatives: I'd like you to indulge me.
I'd like you to play along.
point: humor は相手に合わせてあげること。

ja: 君が無視してたら私はすねてた。
en: If you'd ignored me, I'd have sulked.
alternatives: I'd have sulked if you'd ignored me.
I'd have pouted if you'd ignored me.
point: 過去に実現しなかった条件は had ignored、sulk はすねる。

ja: 言いたいことを言って、少し気が楽だ。
en: Having said my piece, I feel lighter.
alternatives: Having said my piece, I feel a bit better.
Having spoken my mind, I feel lighter.
point: say one's piece は「言いたいことを言う」。Having + 過去分詞

ja: 彼の言葉が、まだ吹っ切れない。
en: I can't get over what he said.
alternatives: I still can't shake what he said.
I still can't let go of what he said.
point: get over は「乗り越える・立ち直る」

ja: 私、君を信じられる。
en: I can trust you.
alternatives: I can count on you.
I can have faith in you.
point: trust は相手を信頼する。

ja: 彼、ほっとしたって言ってたよ。
en: He said he was relieved.
alternatives: He said he felt relieved.
He told me he was relieved.
point: said に合わせて was と過去形にずらす

ja: 私はだいぶ気が楽になった。
en: I feel much more relaxed.
alternatives: I'm feeling far less tense.
I feel a lot calmer.
I'm much more at ease.
point: much は比較級の差を強める。

ja: 雨でも、私は楽しかったよ。
en: Despite the rain, I had fun.
alternatives: Even in the rain, I had fun.
I had fun even though it rained.
point: despite の後ろは名詞。節なら even though

ja: その案、あまり乗り気になれない。
en: I'm not entirely sold on that idea.
alternatives: I'm not sure I'm totally sold on that.
I can't say I'm fully sold on that idea.
point: not entirely でやわらかく否定する

ja: 傘があれば、濡れなかったのに。
en: An umbrella would've kept me dry.
alternatives: I'd have stayed dry with an umbrella.
I wouldn't have gotten wet with an umbrella.
point: 過去の仮定は would have + 過去分詞

ja: 私は不安をもう払拭した。
en: I've put my fears to rest.
alternatives: I've laid my worries to rest.
My fears have now been dispelled.
point: put fears to rest は不安を解消する。

ja: 聞いた知らせ、嬉しかったよ。
en: I loved the news I heard.
alternatives: I was happy about the news I heard.
The news I heard made me happy.
point: 聞いた知らせは news の後ろに置く

ja: もう落ち着いたよ。
en: I've calmed down now.
alternatives: I've settled down now.
I'm calm now.
point: 今の状態につながる完了は現在完了

ja: 彼の言葉に、傷ついたよ。
en: I was hurt by his words.
alternatives: I was hurt by what he said.
What he said hurt me.
point: 傷つけられたは受動態 be hurt

ja: まだ望みはある。
en: There's still hope.
alternatives: Hope still remains.
There is hope yet.
point: hope は数えないので there is。

ja: 試験に受かってほっとした。
en: I was relieved I passed.
alternatives: I felt relieved after passing the exam.
I was relieved to pass the exam.
point: ほっとした＝ relieved（過去の気持ち）

ja: 一番こたえたのは、彼の無関心だった。
en: It was his indifference that stung most.
alternatives: What really got to me was his indifference.
It was his indifference that hurt the most.
point: It was ～ that で強調。sting は心にこたえる

ja: それを聞いて残念です。
en: I'm sorry to hear that.
alternatives: I'm so sorry to hear that.
Sorry to hear that.
point: 「〜して残念」は sorry + to 不定詞

ja: 明日は絶対、緊張するだろうな。
en: I'm going to be nervous tomorrow.
alternatives: I'll be nervous tomorrow.
I'm sure I'll be nervous tomorrow.
I'll definitely be nervous tomorrow.
point: 見込みのある未来は be going to

ja: 私はもう自信を取り戻した。
en: I've regained my confidence.
alternatives: My confidence has returned.
I have my confidence back.
point: regain は失ったものを取り戻す。

ja: あの映画には、思わず泣かされた。
en: That movie made me tear up.
alternatives: That movie made me cry.
That movie got me all teary.
point: make + 人 + 原形で「〜させる」。tear up は泣きそうになる

ja: なんで泣いてるの？
en: Why are you crying?
alternatives: How come you're crying?
What are you crying for?
point: 「今〜している理由」は Why + 進行形

ja: 早く言ってくれてもよかったのに。
en: You could have told me sooner.
alternatives: You should have told me sooner.
You might have told me sooner.
point: could have + 過去分詞で「できたのに」

ja: いい日だね！
en: It's a good day.
alternatives: It's a great day.
Today is a good day.
point: 数えられる名詞 day には a を付ける

ja: 終わったらほっとするよ。
en: I'll be relieved when it's over.
alternatives: I'll be relieved once it's over.
When it's over, I'll be so relieved.
point: when の後は未来でも現在形

ja: どうしたの？
en: What's wrong?
alternatives: What's the matter?
What's the problem?
point: 様子を尋ねる定番。What's wrong? は短くて便利

ja: 私はもう悪い知らせに備えてた。
en: I'd braced myself for bad news.
alternatives: I'd prepared myself for bad news.
I'd been ready for unwelcome news.
point: brace oneself は悪いことに備えて心を構える。

ja: 心配をやめてよ。
en: Stop worrying, please.
alternatives: Please stop fretting.
Please quit worrying.
point: stop の後は worrying の形。

ja: 私は今、悲しい。
en: I'm feeling sad.
alternatives: I feel sad.
I'm sad right now.
point: feeling sad は今の悲しい気持ち。

ja: もう歩けないよ。
en: I can't walk anymore.
alternatives: I can't walk any further.
I can't take another step.
point: 「もう〜できない」は can't + 動詞 + anymore
